segmentation.text: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled
in a business or residential district
and not less than the last 300 feet traveled
This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

elements.justification: A signal of intention is the signal itself, never a declared intention (the ontology: 'a signal "of intention" is the signal'): sig.turn_indicator ('state ∈ {off, left, right}') or sig.hand_signal ('a driver's or rider's arm signal; meaning ∈ {no_signal, left, right, ...}'), of the side of the turn; not a stand-in for the turn itself, which is judged separately through motion. Turning right or left, or otherwise from a direct course, is the heading departing to that side from the designated direction of the carrier the vehicle occupies: drv.lane.heading_offset_from_direction, the signed departure (left positive) of kin.heading from st.lane_direction, on a carrier of kind st.travel_region x occupies (rel.occupies). 'continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled' is a window in distance travelled (a .path window), which reads kin.path_length ('distance travelled along the body's path'); the figure is the law's literal.
'not less than the last 300 feet traveled' is the same .path window over kin.path_length with the law's other literal, the bound selected outside a business or residence district.

Changing the course is the event at which the heading's departure from the occupied carrier's direction (drv.lane.heading_offset_from_direction over kin.heading and st.lane_direction, on a st.travel_region x occupies) first exceeds the course-change tolerance to a side: the observation at which that condition became true. The signal window lies behind it ('prior to').
'a vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway').

assumptions.meaning: The stretch of highway at the observation lies within territory classed as a business district or as a residence district.
The stretch of highway at the observation lies within territory classed as a business district or as a residence district.

residues.why: The words say the rule holds in every weather; no weather condition restricts or extends the duty, which is the same whether or not it rains, snows or is clear.

applicability: x is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle that changes course at the judged observation: x occupies a travel region c with a designated direction, and drv.lane.heading_offset_from_direction(x, c) rises above p.course_change_sin_tolerance (a change to the left) or below its negative (a change to the right) at this observation, not having done so at the observation before (rises).
obligation: At that observation, a signal of the side of the change held at every observation of the window of path length x travelled behind it (holdsFor .path): for a change to the left, sig.turn_indicator state left or sig.hand_signal meaning left; for a change to the right, state right or meaning right. The window's length is selected with Term.cond: the literal 100 ft where asm.business_or_residence_district holds, the literal 300 ft where it does not. A window reaching before the start of the trace leaves the verdict unknown.

narrowings.why: Turning right or left and otherwise turning from a direct course are read as the heading departing from the designated direction of the carrier the vehicle occupies; a change of course made where the vehicle occupies no carrier with a designated direction is not judged.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle in a lane with a designated direction, asm.business_or_residence_district declared true, lights sig.turn_indicator left only over the last 10 m of path before its heading departs to the left of the lane direction beyond the tolerance; the trace covers more than 100 ft behind the change.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same vehicle and district, with sig.turn_indicator left lit at every observation of the last 50 m of path before the heading departs to the left.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle drives along its lane with its heading aligned with the lane direction throughout; no change of course occurs.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle changes course to the left in its lane in a district; the source observes neither turn indicators nor arm signals.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: asm.business_or_residence_district declared false; the vehicle signals right over the last 50 m of path (above 100 ft but below 300 ft) before its heading departs to the right of the lane direction.

param_proposals.name: p.course_change_sin_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Lane-change kinematics: the heading of a vehicle changing lanes or turning departs from the lane direction by about three degrees or more, a smaller departure being in-lane steering correction; the bound is the sine of that angle.
param_proposals.source: Naturalistic lane-change trajectory studies (heading-angle distributions of lane changes, e.g. Toledo and Zohar 2007; NGSIM lane-change analyses).
